decisions.reason: The LED-board Requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the selected LCSC part, model, manufacturer, package, mounting, dimensions, and color channels.
The electrical-interface Requirement already has a same-message MODIFY recording the selected LED identity and physical package relevant to its electrical design.
Selecting a specific LED part does not change the existing connector sourceability rules, which are scoped to standard and replaceable USB connectors.
The selected LED part and package do not change connector-pin marking targets or silkscreen placement.
The LED part selection does not change which rails are monitored, the INA219 topology, or the number of spare monitoring channels.
The LED package's SMD mounting description is unrelated to the panel-mounted button and switch connector assignments.
The LED-board component package does not necessarily alter the power board's dimensions, orientation, holes, or connector clearances.
The switched-rail Requirement already specifies SK6812 LEDs as a 5V load, and the exact manufacturer and package do not change its power-control behavior.
The charge-status Requirement currently uses a future external LED through J_LED_CHG; the selected SK6812MINI-E for the addressable LED design does not change that path.
Choosing the exact LED part does not change the three-board architecture or the defined roles and exclusions of the main and sensor boards.
The source identifies the LED component and package but does not modify any ESP32 GPIO assignment or available-pin rule.
The LED part selection does not change the power board's four-layer stack or dedicated ground-plane strategy.
